partnersOnly.title: Partners only
partnersOnly.body: Infrastructure shows what each website and each client really costs: only partners can see it.

infrastructure.intro: Servers, databases, domains and the websites' software: what they cost, when they renew and what each hosted website costs.

summary.spentHint: {count, plural, =0 {No expenses recorded} one {# expense recorded} other {# expenses recorded}}

renewals.title: Renewals
renewals.description: From the next charge to the furthest one. What alerts and renews {days, plural, one {today or tomorrow} other {in the next # days}} is highlighted.
renewals.empty: No infrastructure subscriptions: one-off expenses count in “Spent in 12 months”.
renewals.caption: Infrastructure subscriptions and their next renewal
renewals.watched: Partners get an alert {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before, in the inbox and on their phone.
renewals.notWatched: Monthly ones only alert from {amount} per charge.

hosting.title: Cost per hosted website
hosting.description: What's shared among hosted websites, split equally among the active ones, and each client's share.
hosting.summary: {count, plural, one {# hosted website} other {# hosted websites}} · {amount} per month
hosting.noSites: There are no active hosted websites in Websites: what's shared among them has nobody to be split among.
hosting.noShared: No running subscription is shared among hosted websites. Assign it to “Hosted websites” in Subscriptions and its cost will be split here and in each client's profitability.

notes.title: How it's calculated
notes.scope: What's included: everything in the infrastructure categories (servers, databases, domains…) and everything shared among hosted websites, whatever its category.
notes.monthly: Per month and per year: the running subscriptions, at their Finance cost (the net amount and, if the VAT isn't deductible, the VAT too). Yearly ones count a twelfth per month; per year, monthly ones × 12 plus yearly ones in full.
notes.spent: Spent in 12 months: the expenses recorded with an invoice date in the last 12 months, including one-off ones and those already generated by subscriptions. It's another way to look at it: it isn't added to the above.
notes.hosting: Cost per hosted website: the monthly cost of the subscriptions shared among hosted websites, split equally among the ones we host that are active in Websites. Each client's profitability counts the same, but with each period's expenses.
notes.renewals: Renewals: each subscription's next charge, on the same calendar that generates its expenses. Partners get an alert {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before yearly ones and monthly ones from {amount} per charge.

empty.title: No infrastructure costs yet
empty.body: Add the servers, databases, domains and the websites' software as subscriptions. Here you'll see what they cost per month and per year, when they renew and what each hosted website costs.
empty.hint: What's in an infrastructure category (servers, databases, domains) or shared among hosted websites is included.

settings.title: Renewal alerts
settings.description: When to tell partners, in the inbox and on their phone, that a subscription renews.
settings.warningDaysHint: How many days before the charge. What renews within those days is highlighted here.
settings.monthlyMinHint: Yearly ones always alert; monthly ones only if each charge (VAT incl.) is at least this amount.
settings.previewOnly: Nothing is saved in the preview.
